title: Pure Chtonian Infernal
summary: Chthonian / Infernal represents Chazz Princeton and Zane Truesdale's aggressive Warrior/Dragon/Fiend beatdown cards from Yu-Gi-Oh! GX, led by Chthonian Emperor Dragon, Chthonian Soldier, and Infernal Incinerator. Combining double-attacking Gemini/Warrior monsters with damage-reflecting traps like Chthonian Blast and Chthonian Polymer, the deck punishes opposing boss monsters and steals Extra Deck summons.

allow.Supervise: Equips to Chthonian Emperor Dragon to immediately unlock its double-attack Gemini effect and revive it if sent to the GY.
allow.Catalyst Field: Allows Level 6 Chthonian Emperor Dragon to be Normal Summoned without Tributing and grants a second Normal Summon.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Searches Chthonian Soldier or Evil HERO Infernal Prodigy.
allow.Superalloy Beast Raptinus: Fusion Monster that automatically grants Chthonian Emperor Dragon its double-attack effect.

main: Level 6 FIRE Dragon Gemini with 2400 ATK that can attack twice during each Battle Phase once Gemini Summoned.
Level 4 DARK Warrior that forces the opponent to also take any battle damage you take when it is destroyed by battle.
Level 8 FIRE Fiend with 2800 ATK that tributes 1 monster with 2000+ ATK to summon itself and gains ATK for every monster the opponent controls.
Level 4 DARK Dragon with 2000 ATK that tributes a monster during the End Phase if it attacked to revive itself from the GY.
Special Summons itself if you control no monsters and draws 1 card during the End Phase if Tributed for a Tribute Summon (like Chthonian Emperor Dragon).
Banishes itself on the field to allow a Fiend monster (like Infernal Incinerator) to attack twice each Battle Phase.
2400 ATK Tribute target that qualifies as the 2000+ ATK tribute for Infernal Incinerator.
Equip Spell that increases the equipped monster's ATK by 800 for every other face-up monster on the field with the same name.
Destroys the face-up monster on the field with the lowest ATK when a monster you control is destroyed and inflicts 500 burn damage to both players.
Tributes 1 monster you control when the opponent Fusion Summons to permanently steal control of that Fusion Monster.
Immediately unlocks Chthonian Emperor Dragon's double attack and revives it when sent to the GY.
Normal Summons Chthonian Emperor Dragon without Tributing.
extra: Rank 4 FIRE Xyz that boosts its ATK by 500 and banishes up to 3 cards from either GY.
Unlocks Chthonian Emperor Dragon's effect automatically.
